# spectral.freq_list { #clerq.spectral.freq_list }

```python
spectral.freq_list(mb_solve)
```

Fourier transform of the tlist into the frequency domain for
spectral analysis.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type    | Description        | Default    |
|----------|---------|--------------------|------------|
| mb_solve | MBSolve | An MBSolve object. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                |
|--------|------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | np.ndarray | Array of frequency values, length ``len(mb_solve.tlist)``. |
